authorizationText: Autorizo un único redeploy sobre el Hosting DEV de visualización ya existente, vinculando CXOrbia read-only a cxorbia-backend-dev para validar Corte 5 con datos reales; sin crear Hosting ni proyecto Firebase adicional, sin nuevos data writes, Auth/Storage/HR/legacy writes, pagos, merge ni producción.
authorizationCarryForwardReason: The reserved one-shot Hosting authorization remained unconsumed pending secure browser Auth. Corte 6 Auth/RBAC and Firestore Rules were verified PASS. The Firebase CLI path was blocked only by its API Keys Viewer dependency, so the authorized deployment was rerouted through the official Firebase Hosting REST API without IAM changes.
rootAliasReason: Firebase Hosting serves exact static content before rewrites. Because app/index.html exists, root / resolves to that exact static file. The dedicated /index-backend-dev.html entrypoint is deployed, HTTP 200, uses the canonical backend config and loads the real Firebase browser Auth gate; it is the canonical DEV visual URL.

preflight.reason: The single existing Hosting DEV redeploy is consumed and verified on the explicit backend DEV entrypoint. No redeploy is allowed. The remaining gate is human authenticated visual validation with existing authorized DEV accounts.
